## Purpose

Produce one ROS workbook per selected ObServe trip, then validate it. Longline is the first target.

## Agreed approach

- Level 1 selects trips in R by date overlap and optional programme IDs; level 2 adds a Shiny interface.
- Export the whole selected trip. Read source data, resolve references, fill the template, then validate.
- Level 1 extracts the source catalogue from ObServe; level 2 uses a compatible public, versioned catalogue.
- Keep one catalogue snapshot per export, including historical entries. Metadata comes from the user.
- V-TRIP uses departure at 00:00 and return at 23:59. Optional vessel attributes await RAV consolidation.

The LL source model contains 18 tables, retaining separate measurements, gear compositions and associations.

Each table has a SQL query using the same single trip ID, with source values and model column order preserved.

[Download the source model](../models/10.0/ll-form.yaml). Equipment-characteristic mappings remain open.

## To decide

Agree source coverage, reference correspondences, identifiers, missing-data rules and failure handling.

Ask Emmanuel which sheets may stay empty, even when their fields are mandatory within a reported row.

ROS database 4.0.0 and form 4.2.0 have independent versions. ROS references need alignment with Reference Data.

The detailed reviews retain field-level evidence and open questions. Resolve these before implementing the exporter.
